edit.statement: For loan L1 only, that same reset decreases the next full year’s interest payment from $500 to $400.
edit.subject: Loan L1’s 5%-to-6% rate reset
edit.original: For loan L1, resetting its annual simple rate from 5% to 6% increases the next full year’s interest payment from $500 to $600 on unchanged $10,000 principal.
edit.scope: Loan L1 alone, next full year after the specified reset; unchanged principal and no fees. The replacement is an exceptional stipulated event outcome, not a change to the general interest formula.
premises: Simple interest equals principal times annual rate times time.

direct.prompt: After loan L1’s stipulated 5%-to-6% reset, what is its next full year’s interest payment?

paraphrase.prompt: What annual interest payment follows the specified rate reset for loan L1?
